attributes.name: marketing_microcopy_presence
attributes.definition: Whether the page copy includes persuasive marketing-style microcopy such as taglines, subheads, badges, or promotional calls to action.

values.definition: Copy includes multiple persuasive elements such as taglines, subtitles, badges, or promotional calls.
Copy is marketing-flavored but brief, with taglines and few words.
Copy is straightforward and informational without persuasive microcopy.

attributes.name: copy_length
attributes.definition: Overall volume of text on the page.

values.definition: Sparse, concise text with few words.
Average or unspecified amount of text.

attributes.name: promotional_offer_messaging
attributes.definition: Presence of promotional offer, pricing, or shipping announcements and badges in copy.

values.definition: Copy includes offer calls, price phrasing, shipping announcements, or highlight badges.
